summary: Redesign roles, plan reskilling, and measure AI-enabled hybrid work. Explore practical leadership tools and course outcomes.
lede: AI-augmented hybrid team leadership coordinates human and AI contributions across remote and on-site work. For HR leaders, line managers, and team leads, this course develops practical ways to map tasks and decision accountability, prioritize skills gaps and reskilling, and choose measures for team outcomes, workload, quality, and adoption. Participants also practise setting human-review and escalation points and planning trust-building change communication.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set people practices or lead teams where AI tools, remote work, and on-site work intersect.
modules: RACI Role Redesign for AI Work
prerequisites: Working familiarity with team leadership, HR operations, workforce planning, or organizational change is recommended. No coding or AI model-building experience is required. Participants should bring a non-confidential example of a hybrid workflow or role affected by AI, if available. Advanced AI governance and workforce analytics are addressed at conceptual or operational application level.
